sentences.text: Appeal is admitted for final hearing.
Also heard on I.A.No.18781/2025 an application under Section 389(1) of the Cr.P.C./430 of BNSS for suspension of sentence and grant of bail to appellant.
The appellant has been convicted under Section 376(1) of IPC and sentenced to undergo RI for 10 years with fine of Rs.2,000/- and under Section 3/4 of POCSO Act, with default stipulations.
Learned counsel for the appellant, after referring to testimony of prosecutrix (PW-2), submits that it is a case of consensual relationship.
It is also urged that prosecutrix had left her house at her own.
It is also urged that prosecutrix had informed appellant that she is aged more than 18 years.
Appellant is in jail since 18.11.2022.
During trial, appellant was in jail from 16.9.2020 to 26.11.2020.
It is also urged that no injuries have been found on the person of the prosecutrix.
Further, prosecutrix was having mobile phone but she never informed her parents/family members about the incident.
This appeal is of the year, 2023 & final hearing of this appeal is not possible in near future.
Thus, it is prayed that the 2 CRA-9807-2023 remaining jail sentence of the appellant may be suspended.
Learned Panel Lawyer for the respondent/State on the other hand has opposed the application.

Considering the overall facts and circumstances of the case and coupled with the fact that the final hearing of this appeal is not possible in near future, I deem it proper to suspend the jail sentence of the appellant.
